headline: MIA @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.82 at TBR 4.36, with a projected total of 8.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +0.83 runs while TBR moved -0.28, changing the projected margin by +1.11 runs. The projected total climbed +0.56, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Janson Junk has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Jonathan Aranda, Chandler Simpson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Javier Sanoja, Esteury Ruiz because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
